tracks.title: today is my favorite
tracks.excerpt: An album-length EP by the 20-year-old producer is a dizzying and boundless collage of collages, using free-jazz logic and digital overload to chart new emotional terrain.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位20岁的制片人制作了一张专辑长度的EP ，这是一张令人眼花缭乱的无限拼贴画，使用自由爵士逻辑和数字过载来绘制新的情感地形。

tracks.title: The thing
tracks.excerpt: The Danish artist achieves a beguiling flow state on her second solo album: a set of future standards full of empty space.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位丹麦艺术家在她的第二张个人专辑中实现了一种迷人的流动状态：一套充满空旷空间的未来标准。

One thing is undeniable: October and November are the months for The Clientele's 2000 debut album Suburban Light . tracks.title: This is How it Should Be Done
tracks.excerpt: For their collaborative full-length debut, Eris Drew and Octo Octa hunkered down in their New Hampshire cabin to craft a celebratory, sample-heavy tribute to the maximalist dance music of yore.
tracks.excerpt_zh: Eris Drew和Octo Octa在他们的新罕布什尔州小木屋里蹲下，为他们合作的全长首演制作了一个庆祝性的样品，向昔日的极致舞曲致敬。

tracks.title: School's Out!
tracks.excerpt: The irreverent duo of Leo Fincham and Rowan Please plies its brilliantly digitized indie-pop bricolage on an album with the ragtag splendor of a low-budget musical.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 不敬的Leo Fincham和Rowan Please二人组合将其精彩的数字化独立流行拼凑在一张专辑中，并伴随着低成本音乐剧的破烂辉煌。

tracks.title: Winning a Battle, Losing the War
tracks.netease_title: Winning A Battle, Losing The War
tracks.excerpt: The muted hues, the subdued texture of the light, the encroaching dusk. There’s a sort of unspoken beautiful melancholy to autumn that has nothing to do with gloom or sadness. It hangs in the air, soft at the edges. Released 25 years ago this year, Kings of Convenience’s Quiet Is the New Loud gave that aching melancholy a voice. The post Kings of Convenience :: Quiet Is the New Loud first appeared
tracks.excerpt_zh: 柔和的色调，柔和的光线质地，蚕食的黄昏。秋天有一种不言而喻的美丽忧郁，与忧郁或悲伤无关。它悬挂在空中，边缘柔软。今年发布的25年前， Kings of Convenience的《Quiet Is the New Loud》给了那痛苦忧郁的声音。帖子Kings of Convenience:: Quiet Is the New Loud首次出现
